basisKind: Explicit legacy validation precondition from beta audit A01/A02; no new XSD structural semantics
decision: After existing null checks, snapshot compile diagnostics once; any finding returns false before typed focus, lookup, assertion/alternative compilation or evaluation. Preserve code/message/path/order without translating to a new finding.
intentionalRestrictions: Every compile finding blocks because SchemaDiagnostic has no severity model
Clean compiled models retain assertion/facet/static-check semantics; success does not certify arbitrary structural validity
No new native outcome or W3C diagnostic code
Legacy detailed diagnostic text is copied, not redacted or bounded like native stage diagnostics
Caller-created result records and arbitrary custom ICompiledSchema implementations remain application data
No broader lexical exception normalization or complete xsi:type/type-derivation validation
versionPolicy: Bug fix within unreleased 0.5 feature line; no tag, Version override or publication.
